candidate.answerReason: The 2004 powers occupy 603 complete digit-length groups. Each group has three or four powers and contains one leading-4 power exactly when it has four. Thus the count is 2004−3·603=195.

methods.label: Group the powers by digit length
methods.explanation:
Successive powers of two double, so grouping them by their number of decimal digits lets us control how many powers occur in each group.

The information about \(2^{2004}\) means
\[
10^{603}\leq2^{2004}<2\cdot10^{603}.
\]
Dividing by \(2\) shows that \(2^{2003}<10^{603}\). Thus \(S\) contains exactly all powers of two below \(10^{603}\), grouped into the \(603\) possible digit lengths from \(1\) through \(603\).

Consider one digit length. Write \(T=10^j\), so its numbers lie in \([T,10T)\), and let \(p\) be the smallest power of two in this interval. Then
\[
T\leq p<2T.
\]
For \(T>1\), the upper bound follows because the preceding power \(p/2\) is below \(T\); for \(T=1\), it follows directly from \(p=1\).

The powers \(p,2p,4p\) all lie below \(10T\), while \(16p\geq16T\) does not. Hence this digit-length group contains either three powers or four, depending on whether \(8p<10T\).

Only \(4p\) can start with \(4\): the first two powers are below \(4T\), and the possible fourth is at least \(8T\). Since \(4p\geq4T\), it starts with \(4\) exactly when
\[
4p<5T
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
8p<10T.
\]
Therefore each four-power group contains exactly one leading-\(4\) power, and each three-power group contains none.

Let \(N\) be the number of four-power groups. Counting the same \(2004\) powers by their digit-length groups gives
\[
2004=4N+3(603-N)=1809+N.
\]
Every power belongs to exactly one group, so the desired count is \(N=\boxed{195}\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).

The proof handles the initial group, the final cutoff, and the one-to-one correspondence between four-power groups and leading-4 powers.

review.mathematicalCheck: The given leading digit makes \(2^{2004}\) the first power with 604 digits. Each of the 603 preceding digit-length groups contains three or four powers. Its sole possible leading-4 member is \(4p\), which qualifies exactly when the fourth power \(8p\) remains in the group. Thus the count is \(2004-3\cdot603=195\).
